notes: נְדִיב לִבּוֹ is recast as is of a willing heart: the copula and willing go to the adjective, of a heart to the noun, and the suffix is left unrendered.
אֵת at s003 is the preposition H854 (among), not the object marker; the two markers at s014 and s021... only s014 stands here and is unrepresented (rule 16).
